method: Read existing freeze manifests and receipts; hash source, manifest, input, answer and report bytes. No experiments, grading, scientific calculations, tests, external writes or publication operations rerun.

primary_confirmation.scope: retrospective public-source computational audit; no physical/customer acceptance

prospective_confirmation.scope: four fresh requests on previously used sources; supplements immutable first pass; no physical/customer acceptance

fresh_transfer.graph_specific_value: not established; identical-content ordinary library is the parity control

hosted_expertise.grading: Independent AI-assisted adjudication against unchanged mandatory criteria and fatal-error list, with answer-line evidence. Exact identifiers must remain unambiguous across an actionable answer.
hosted_expertise.strict_identifier_criterion: The enhanced answer states the correct full serial once but later uses the component ID as a serial in its requested next action. Strict complete acceptance requires resolving that conflict; it was not corrected.
hosted_expertise.lenient_reading: If the correct table entry alone were sufficient and the conflicting action ignored, Eplus would be 4/4. That is not the exact-identifier acceptance applied here; either reading establishes no additional accepted-quality gain.

economics.all_economic_results: assumed/simulated; not observed market or finance validation

limits: All prices, resources and costs are original research assumptions
Original selected commitments, including subsequently cancelled plans, are audited
Full committed work is a conservative adverse envelope, not a probability or realized loss
Other contractual nonperformance, legal acceptance, strategic behavior and late payments are unmodeled
No expected-profit, recovered-confirmation or new-customer claim

native_accounting.scope: settled terminal net-cash projection only; authoritative chronology, deposits, refunds, receivables and noncash writeoffs remain in original research ledger and signed event journal
native_accounting.earlier_attempt_failure_preserved: Native signed-record commitments reject floating-point values. The attempted original-event journal payload contained floats.

prior_demo_receipt.scope: Earlier exact artifact: all 32 explorer states and original controls.

publication_qa_receipts.limit: Existing QA receipts only. Documents may be rebuilt during publication; this audit does not independently re-render or approve deployment.
publication_qa_receipts.root_reported_final_visual_review: Root reports review of all pages via contact sheets and detailed cover/table/figure pages; final 32/3/6 pages, no overfull warnings, missing glyphs, outside-20pt blocks, attachments/widgets/JavaScript. No independent re-render in this audit.

publication_disclosure.paper_retrospective_statement: publication/PAPER_BODY.md, section preceding First protected result

not_performed_in_final_audit: Full repository CI or release qualification
Live customer trial, human-service comparison or sales
Physical manufacturing measurement, substitution or part release
Live ENS authentication or native production manufacturing-scope admission
Canonical Pages deployment, software release, or upstream publication approval
interpretive_limits: Hash equality checks integrity against recorded manifests, not truth of all assumptions or independence of historical timestamps.
Independent evaluator is separately implemented and AI-assisted on the same host; CAD geometry shares the OCP kernel.
Field checks and repeated scenarios are not independent customers or physical samples.
Recorded elapsed durations do not establish complete research cost, customer effort, active model latency, or accepted-quality cost superiority.
The original 5/8 result, three failures, rejected candidates, earlier failed accounting replay and adverse solvency result remain preserved.
A useful accepted audit can correctly reject physical reuse; audit acceptance is not part-release acceptance.
